scope: Refresh database-written opening metadata before two retirement test actions

operator_result_before_fix.exception: ValidationError while save_reference checks immutable approved opening metadata

cause: The fixtures create an account with an opening date. The existing S19 PostgreSQL BEFORE INSERT trigger fills opening_approved_at, but the newly created Python instance still has its pre-trigger value. save_reference normalizes money then compares all protected opening fields against a fresh locked database row, so the stale approval timestamp correctly prevents the test's retirement action.
change: Refresh the persisted destination account immediately before setting is_active=False in each affected test. Preserve all financial assertions and the complete retirement/retry checks.
